original_benchmark.notes: Full upstream ibm-research/ITBench-Lite sre-domain snapshot has 35 scenarios (Scenario-N dirs, non-contiguous numbering).

harbor_adapter.notes: All 35 scenarios in the upstream ibm-research/ITBench-Lite sre-domain snapshot have been generated into Harbor tasks (datasets/itbench-lite/harbor_tasks/scenario-<N>/) and the oracle scores reward=1.0 on all of them. Answer schema is single-cause (root_cause/kind/namespace/reasoning/propagation_chain); multi-independent-cause incidents and full alert-coverage scoring are out of scope -- see REVIEW_AGAINST_ITBENCH_REFERENCE.md gap #2.
